paragraphs.source_en: The garden contained many cherry trees, and their branches were crawling with caterpillars. As the maids solemnly and anxiously made preparations for Okame's Tanabata celebration, they constantly watched lest a caterpillar fall on them. Some busied themselves hanging colored paper from dwarf-bamboo branches, some arranged tables and stools in the garden, some carried candlestands, and others laid out the offerings. Afraid that caterpillars might fall upon them, the maids came and went with the utmost caution.
